definitions.explanation: A large, open-topped bag with parallel handles, used for carrying everyday items. From English 'tote bag.'

examples.japanese: トートバッグ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put my things in the tote bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トートバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a cloth tote bag for shopping.

examples.japanese: ⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{有料|ゆうりょう}→有料：03178_yuuryou⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、トートバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Since plastic bags became paid, more people carry tote bags around.

notes:
A loanword from English 'tote bag.' In Japan, tote bags became especially popular after the introduction of charges for plastic shopping bags (⟦レジ{袋|ぶくろ}→レジ袋：09531_rejibukuro⟧{有料化|ゆうりょうか}) in 2020. Many people carry a folding tote bag as an eco-bag (⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧) for shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トートバッグ: cloth tote bag
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トートバッグ: leather tote bag
- トートバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to carry a tote bag
- ⟦{折|お}りたたみ→折りたたみ：11332_oritatami⟧トートバッグ: folding tote bag

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧: eco-bag; reusable shopping bag — often a tote bag used as a plastic bag replacement
- ⟦{手提|てさ}げ→手提げ：18403_tesage⟧{袋|ぶくろ}: handbag; carry bag — general term for any bag with handles
- ⟦ショルダーバッグ→ショルダーバッグ：08987_shorudaabaggu⟧: shoulder bag — worn over the shoulder, unlike a tote
